justification: DB filter + null guard fixes across 5 API routes — affects data correctness in production queries

pre_impl.existing_data: dcp_setback_controls (is_current column), regulatory_provisions (v2_is_actionable column), development_controls (joined to rp), development_permissions
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: If is_current or v2_is_actionable columns don't exist, queries will throw SQL errors — but both confirmed in migrations and existing usage
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Applies to all existing queries immediately — tightens WHERE filters to exclude superseded/inactive rows

functions.name: GET (canibuildit/check)
functions.if_none: Empty array — non-blocking, caught by try/catch

functions.name: getComplianceRules
functions.output: fsrRules/heightRules/siteCoverageRules arrays of development control objects

functions.name: GET (parking-rates)
functions.input: lga + developmentType from URL query params
functions.output: parking rate JSON response with rate and source
functions.if_none: Falls through to fallback with found:false

functions.name: getZoneStats
functions.input: zone string from property lookup context
functions.output: stats object with total_provisions, dev_type_count, linked_standards

values.nullable: yes — rows[0] could be undefined if upstream logic changes
values.if_missing: Returns 'unknown' permission status instead of crashing

values.nullable: yes — COUNT(*) always returns a row but defensive guard added

queries.purpose: Fetch DCP setback controls for granny flat eligibility
queries.where_clause: lga = $1 AND dev_type = 'secondary_dwelling' AND is_current = TRUE
queries.if_wrong: Previously returned superseded controls; now filtered to current

queries.purpose: Fetch FSR/height/coverage from development_controls joined to regulatory_provisions
queries.where_clause: dc.control_type = X AND zone_applicable = $1 AND rp.v2_is_actionable = true
queries.if_wrong: Previously could join to inactive provisions; now filtered

queries.purpose: Fetch DCP parking provisions for TOD parking rates
queries.where_clause: d.council_name ILIKE $1 AND rp.v2_is_actionable = true AND parking ILIKE filters
queries.if_zero: Falls through to fallback with found:false
queries.if_wrong: Previously returned superseded parking provisions; now filtered

break_it.scenario: v2_is_actionable column doesn't exist on regulatory_provisions
break_it.what_happens: SQL error on live-compliance-client and parking-rates queries
break_it.how: Column confirmed in DB_SCHEMA.md (10,008 actionable of 46,585) and used in 20+ other queries

break_it.scenario: is_current column doesn't exist on dcp_setback_controls
break_it.what_happens: SQL error on canibuildit granny flat query
break_it.how: Column confirmed in migration 032 and indexed at (lga, dev_type, is_current)

break_it.scenario: All provisions for a council have v2_is_actionable=false
break_it.what_happens: Parking rates returns 0 rows, API returns found:false
break_it.how: Existing fallback at line 145 checks rows.length > 0

break_it.scenario: development_controls row references provision where v2_is_actionable is false (superseded provision)
break_it.what_happens: Previously returned stale FSR/height/coverage data; now correctly excluded by filter
break_it.how: frontend-nextjs/lib/database/specialized/live-compliance-client.ts:148 — AND rp.v2_is_actionable = true on all 3 queries
break_it.repro: Hit /api/compliance/live-check with a zone that has superseded provisions
